proof_scope: Corrected-goal proof-boundary admission. Offline retained-artifact fail-closed replay plus deterministic fault injection; no paid/browser/provider calls and no generated positive earns real-world readiness. Tau provenance checks validate producer-owned receipt structure/hash fields, not cryptographic unforgeability against a malicious filesystem writer.

claims.proves: The corrected-goal adjudicator fails closed when source-memory bytes, manifest identity digest, identity artifact bytes, imported dynamic-conversation receipts/transcripts/audio, chatterbox delivery metrics, or exact gate schemas/status/live/mock bindings are absent or inconsistent.
claims.does_not_prove: A complete retained positive proof, fresh Memory retrieval, live provider availability, WebGPT/WebKimi/Kling readiness, human-perceived emotional value, canonical identity availability for historical runs, or cryptographic unforgeability against a malicious filesystem writer.

capability_claims.description: Corrected-goal proof admission requires independently read artifact bytes and fails closed instead of accepting manifest-only source-memory, identity digest, dynamic-conversation, delivery, or gate claims.

cases.name: corrected-goal-proof-boundaries-fail-closed
cases.description: Runs the actual corrected-goal adjudicator against deterministic negative mutations and current retained artifacts. Retained real artifacts are used only to prove fail-closed behavior when canonical identity/provenance evidence is absent; synthetic internal coverage is not labeled live and is expected to block. Tau receipt checks validate structure and hash-shaped fields, not malicious-writer resistance.
